item.description:
## What's new
- **Clearer name for the OptiQ DFlash2 model.** `Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-OptiQ-DFLASH2-4bit` is now `Ornith-1.5-35B-A3B-OptiQ-4bit-vision-DFLASH2`, named like every other model with a built-in draft model: model, quantizer, bits, vision, draft model. - **Your copy carries over.** If you already downloaded it under the old name, it stays on this Mac under the renamed row and keeps working under the name you know. Nothing downloads again.
## Fixes
- **Get works again for that model.** After it moved to its new name on Hugging Face, 0.2.133 and earlier could no longer download it.
## Compatibility
Your models, conversations and settings are kept. No setting, command or local API changed.
This release is signed with a Developer ID, built with Hardened Runtime and notarized by Apple.
